This is causing many to rethink about returning to Nepal or to leave Nepal after becoming frustrated with the TU people here.  I know folks who have masters and PhD degrees from western countries. They struggle to get equivalence at TU because TU doesn't have a comparable degree program or study route as found in western universities. If you study a field not found at TU, getting equivalence is very difficult. Also, TU may not give equivalence for masters degree if the field of study is different than the bachelor's degree. Same goes with PhD. They make a big issue on how one can go from one degree to another, even if it was completely legal overseas. If equivalence is not granted for masters, then it will not be granted for PhD. Even those who study in India are at risk of not getting equivalence. Hence, you have cases where people can get equivalent certificates from other foreign countries but not from Nepal!
